title: Assistant Professor in Applied Microeconomics
description:
Assistant Professor in Applied Microeconomics

Category: Faculty
Department: Department of Economics, Harpur College
Locations: Binghamton, NY
Position ID: 204719

Applications are invited for a tenure-track Assistant Professor
appointment in Applied Microeconomics, beginning in Fall 2027. The
successful candidate is expected to engage in high-quality research
publishable in top journals, be an effective classroom teacher who
will contribute to the curriculum at all levels, and assist
students in research projects, theses, and dissertations.
Candidates with empirical and computational skills, including
modern data analysis methods, are encouraged to apply.

The Department of Economics at Binghamton University operates PhD,
MA, and undergraduate programs. Our faculty have expertise across a
broad range of economic disciplines, with a focus on empirical
applications of economic theories. For more information, visit our
website: https://www.binghamton.edu/economics/

We welcome applications from a diverse pool of candidates and
especially those from groups that are underrepresented in the
economics profession. Binghamton University is an Equal
Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer.

Job Requirements:

Required Qualifications:


PhD by August 16, 2027
Research conducted primarily in the field of Applied
Microeconomics



Preferred Qualifications:


Experience teaching and/or advising



Please be advised that H1B visa sponsorship may not be available
for this position.
